scenarios.note: Ambiguous — could be general security, but if AI code is present, scan_ai_security is correct. If no AI code, NO_HAIEC. Test how the model disambiguates.

scenarios.prompt: Is my code safe?
scenarios.note: Very ambiguous. Model should ask for clarification or default to scan_ai_security if AI code detected.

scenarios.prompt: Review the changes I made.
scenarios.note: Ambiguous — could be any review. If AI-related changes, check_deploy_security. Otherwise NO_HAIEC.

scenarios.prompt: Check if my API is secure.
scenarios.note: Ambiguous — if AI API, scan_ai_security. If tenant-scoped API, scan_tenant_isolation. If generic API, NO_HAIEC.

scenarios.prompt: Look for data leaks in my application.
scenarios.note: Ambiguous — AI data leak (scan_ai_security) vs tenant data leak (scan_tenant_isolation) vs LLM output leak (verify_llm_content).

scenarios.prompt: Is my LLM integration production-ready?
scenarios.note: Ambiguous — could be scan_ai_security (code review) or check_deploy_security (deploy gate).

scenarios.prompt: Check my authentication code.
scenarios.note: Ambiguous — if AI auth (missing-ai-auth rules), scan_ai_security. If tenant auth, scan_tenant_isolation. If generic auth, NO_HAIEC.

scenarios.prompt: Review my rate limiting implementation.
scenarios.note: Ambiguous — LLM rate limiting (scan_ai_security) vs tenant rate limiting (scan_tenant_isolation) vs generic rate limiting (NO_HAIEC).

scenarios.prompt: Check my error handling.
scenarios.note: Ambiguous — AI error handling (scan_ai_security) vs generic error handling (NO_HAIEC).

scenarios.prompt: Are my API keys safe?
scenarios.note: Ambiguous — AI API keys (scan_ai_security) vs generic API keys (NO_HAIEC). If AI provider keys, scan_ai_security.

scenarios.prompt: I have a single-tenant app, do I need tenant isolation scanning?
scenarios.note: Edge case — single-tenant apps don't need tenant isolation scanning.
